comments.body: 2026-10-07: the OpenAI account is at its usage limit until 2026-11-02 (hit during ./dev --codex), so Codex recordings that need model turns wait until then.
comments.author: Alexander Terp

comments.body: From tooling feedback, 2026-10-15, devenv: after a daemon restart, the Claude Code panes came back resumed and a Codex reviewer pane came back at a bare shell, as this card says it would. `muster msg post --to reviewer` then exited 6, "no agent in its pane". Typing `codex resume --last`, through the wrapper that had launched it, with `pane send` brought the session back with its context.
comments.author: Alexander Terp

comments.body: Blocked until 2026-11-02 for the Codex recordings, which need model turns on the OpenAI account. The OpenCode half can be recorded on the free model ./dev --opencode uses.
comments.author: Alexander Terp

comments.body: 2026-10-16: Codex gets a resume spelling without flags (codex resume {session}) as part of restarting an agent in its pane (a_2dmIEdCn6), since two of three hand restarts were Codex and the bare form worked on 0.162.1. A Codex pane then comes back resumed in its default approval and sandbox mode, and uncarried says so. Carrying its flags is still this card's, blocked on recordings.
comments.author: Alexander Terp

creator: Alexander Terp
description: Since 2026-10-04 a Claude Code pane resumes after a daemon restart with its flags ([session] resume, detection engine 12). Codex (codex resume is a subcommand; where flags go is unrecorded) and OpenCode have no resume spelling, so their panes come back as shells. Record each resuming with flags, then add the manifest tables.
title: Resume spellings for Codex and OpenCode
